This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail in relation to FIR No. 44/2023 registered at Police Station Udaipura, District-Raisen for the offences under Section 363, 366-(a), 376 (2)(n), 376 (3) of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
He is in detention since 14.02.2023.

Prosecution story in brief is that on 04.02.2023 prosecutrix aged about 17 years and 8 months was found missing from her house and thereafter report was lodged by father of the prosecutrix with Ashish Kumar Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191166844/
1 regard to missing of her daughter and commission of rape.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 14.02.2023 i.e. for more than 2 months.

sentences.text: It is submitted that that in the statement under section 161 of Cr.P.C. prosecutrix has stated that she wants to live with the applicant and wants to marry him.
He has been falsely implicated.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail, pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.

Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that trial of the case will take considerable time, the applicant has been in custody from 14.02.2023, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.
I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
